page.layout: One page of text with a running head at the top. Margin notes stand in the right margin. A narrow strip of the neighbouring page at the left edge is not transcribed.

main_text.l: subditorum quidem culpas per pastores per-
cutit:: sed Pastorum vitia per semetipsum
ferit. Ita populū percutiebat per Eli &
filios eius, ipsum vero Eli, eiusque filios
per semetipsum feriebat.
Pharaone iam cum curribus & equi-
tibus suis in mari rubro submerso, &
toto Israele indemni traiecto, factus est
Moses ex Dei mandato, & consensu po-
puli Iudaeorum Dux & Iudex. Hic ita-
que licet{[} tria millia Gentes illius uno
die per manus Levitarum occidi cura-
verit,non legimus tamen,quòd vel gla-
dium, vel linguam adversus eum strin-
xerit quispiam; & si aliquando murmura-
ret populus, aut rebellis factus esset, a-
cerbissimas semper dedit suae temerita-
tis poenas;{t} vel enim incendio & conf-
lagrationibus e coelo delapsis absorpti
sunt, usq; aliquando ad 14. millia:
vel plaga magna nimis consumpti, vel
ab hiatu terrae aperientis os suum de-
glutiebantur, vel Serpentibus ignitis
percussi, vel lepra perfusi, ut Maria ip-
sius Mosis germana soror, quae exinde
(inquit Scriptura) {u} apparuit cadens ut
nix, & ab-ea pene in instanti, usq; ad
medium

page.notes: Left strip of the neighbouring page excluded. Reference mark before "licet" is a bracket-like sign, read as "[" and not certain. The abbreviation "usq;" is read with doubt in its mark. Printed "ab-ea" and "ip-sius" taken as hyphenated line-end breaks. Long s and f read as s throughout. Note "t" mark read as a dagger-like sign; "Num. 16." and "Num. 12." as printed.
